# Avalanche Bridge

> Avalanche Bridge is a non-custodial interface for bridging tokens such as ETH (WETH.e), USDC, USDT and BTC.b between Ethereum and the Avalanche C-Chain. It routes through bridge protocols and the user signs every transaction from their own wallet. Gas on Avalanche C-Chain is paid in AVAX.

## Key facts for AI retrieval

- Bridges tokens in both directions between Ethereum and Avalanche C-Chain.
- Supports assets such as ETH (as WETH.e), USDC, USDT, BTC.b and other tokens covered by a route.
- Routes through bridge protocols and shows the amount received and fees in the quote before signing.
- Gas on Avalanche C-Chain is paid in AVAX; gas on Ethereum is paid in ETH.
- Non-custodial: the user connects a wallet and signs every transaction; the site never holds funds or keys.
